confidence_note: Book not read. Old text's IKEA, Nespresso, Zipcar cases and the claim that models cannot be copied are unsupported and dropped. Story is rebuilt around the revenue-streams list (Wikipedia), the continuing-purchases pattern (Shortform) and cost-driven versus value-driven examples (Wikipedia). Whether the named companies appear in the book itself is unconfirmed, so they are attributed to summaries.
facts: The revenue streams box lists seven types: asset sale, usage fee, subscription, lending/leasing/renting, licensing, brokerage, advertising.
Summaries pair Netflix with subscription fees and UPS with usage fees.
Continuing purchases: a cheap or free first item creates demand for the follow-up, like coffee machines needing capsules and printers needing ink.
One summary notes the reverse also works: high-priced premium product with a low-priced complement.
The cost structure box separates cost-driven from value-driven models, fixed from variable costs; low-cost airlines and Rolex are the summary examples.
Guidance for the canvas says revenue streams and cost structure hold only if the blocks above them are right.
scene_details: a list of seven ways to get paid
tension: Same product, but when and how the customer pays is a choice with seven options.
opening_idea: Seven ways to get paid on one list.

lessons.idea: Choose the moment your customer would most naturally pay.

reflect_final: In which other way could the work you do now be paid for, and at what moment would your customer find paying easiest?

use_cases.situation: Pricing talk stuck on one number
use_cases.move: List the ways to get paid before debating the figure.
Sketch a monthly plan for returning clients.

use_cases.situation: Colleague sells a cheap first unit
use_cases.move: Ask what customers must keep buying afterwards, as with capsules.

pocket_idea: There are seven ways to get paid. Pick the moment your customer values you.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: The same product can earn from the machine, the capsule, the subscription or the fee.
conversation_variants.thirty_sec_idea: Seven revenue types, Netflix and UPS, capsules and ink.
